general.uiLanguage.title: Interface Language
general.uiLanguage.description: Language used for the app interface
general.language.title: Output Language
general.language.description: Select 'Auto' for multi-language auto-detection. Choose a specific language to ensure transcription output is always in that language.
general.language.bilingualHint: When a clip is too short to identify, transcription falls back to the first language in the list.
general.hotkey.title: Hotkey
general.mic.title: Microphone
general.behavior.title: Behavior
general.behavior.launchStartupDesc: Start Whisperi when you log in to Windows
general.behavior.autoPasteDesc: Copy transcribed text to clipboard and paste into the active window
general.behavior.soundEffectsDesc: Play a sound when recording starts and stops
transcription.title: Cloud Provider
transcription.mode.label: Mode
transcription.mode.standard.description: Records, then transcribes when you stop.
transcription.mode.live.description: Types directly into the focused window as you speak. AI enhancement applies after you stop.
transcription.live.description: Live mode streams your microphone audio to {{provider}} while typing each utterance into your focused window. The full transcript is polished by AI after you stop.
transcription.live.apiKeyRequired: API key required — open Settings → Other Tab to add one
transcription.live.enhancement.label: Polish text on stop
transcription.live.enhancement.descripti: Re-run AI enhancement when you stop. Replaces the live-typed text with the polished version (visible backspace + retype). Turn off to leave words exactly as spoken.
transcription.live.missing.consent: Consent (a dialog will appear in this section)
transcription.live.lastError.title: Last Live attempt failed
transcription.live.ready: ✓ Live mode ready — press your dictation hotkey to start.
transcription.live.notReady: Live mode is not ready yet. Configure:
enhancement.disabledByLive.title: Enhancement is bypassed
enhancement.disabledByLive.body: You're in Live mode with "Polish text on stop" turned off, so these settings don't run on any session. Turn the toggle back on in Transcription, or switch to Standard mode, to use them.
enhancement.title: AI Enhancement
enhancement.description: Post-process transcriptions with an AI reasoning model
enhancement.enableDesc: Clean up grammar, punctuation, and formatting
enhancement.lastError.title: Last text cleanup failed
enhancement.lastError.hint: Your dictation was inserted without cleanup. Check the model and API key above.
enhancement.prompt.title: System Prompt
enhancement.prompt.description: Cleanup instructions sent to the AI model. Core behavior rules are applied automatically.
enhancement.prompt.placeholder: Enter your custom cleanup instructions here. Core behavior rules (agent activation, output format) are always applied automatically.
enhancement.intensity.title: Enhancement Intensity
enhancement.intensity.description: Controls how much the AI modifies your transcribed text
enhancement.intensity.lightDesc: Minimal cleanup — remove fillers and fix punctuation only
enhancement.intensity.standardDesc: Full cleanup with formatting and self-correction handling
enhancement.intensity.fullDesc: Aggressive polish — restructure and improve wording
whatsNew.title: What's New in v{{version}}
whatsNew.noChangelog: No changelog available for this version.
dictionary.title: Custom Dictionary
dictionary.description: Teach transcription the correct spelling of names, jargon, and terms it commonly mishears.
dictionary.aliases.label: May be heard as
dictionary.policy.label: Correction
dictionary.policy.contextualDescription: Correct an alias only when the surrounding words indicate this term.
dictionary.policy.alwaysDescription: Replace every whole-word alias locally, even when AI enhancement is off.
dictionary.empty: No custom words added. Add names, technical terms, or brand names to improve accuracy.
agent.name.title: Agent Name
agent.name.description: When you say this name during dictation, the AI switches from transcription cleanup to conversational response mode — it will answer questions and follow instructions instead of just cleaning up your speech.
agent.aliases.title: Aliases (optional)
agent.aliases.description: Alternate spellings or transliterations of the agent name. Useful when speech-to-text misrecognizes non-English names. Up to 2 aliases.
developer.debug.title: Debug Mode
developer.debug.description: When enabled, the output includes labeled sections for both the raw transcription and the AI-enhanced result, so you can compare them side by side.
developer.data.title: Data
about.title: Whisperi
about.description: Desktop dictation with cloud and local transcription. Built with Tauri and React.
about.updates.title: Updates
about.updates.networkError: Could not reach the update server. The repository may be private or the network is unavailable.
dictation.live.consent.title: Enable Live mode with {{provider}}
dictation.live.consent.body: Live mode streams your microphone audio continuously to {{provider}} for as long as the session is active. Audio is subject to their privacy policy. Live mode uses ~156 MB/hour of network data — avoid on metered connections.
dictation.live.error.noApiKey: No API key for {{provider}}. Open Settings → Other Tab to add one.
dictation.live.error.liveLanguageAuto: Live mode requires an explicit output language. Open Settings → General to set one.
dictation.live.error.terminalFocus: Paused: Live mode does not type into terminal windows. Switch focus to enable.
dictation.live.info.focusDrifted: Polish skipped — you switched windows mid-dictation. Your dictated text is preserved as-is.
overlay.notification.title: Whisperi
overlay.notification.liveStarted.title: Live mode active
providerModel.openRouterHint: Enter any model from <link> in {{format}} format

noDevice.title: No microphone detected
noDevice.body: Whisperi couldn't find a microphone, so recording can't start. Connect a microphone and make sure it's enabled in your system sound settings, then try again.

selectedMissing.title: Microphone unavailable
selectedMissing.body: Your selected microphone "{{device}}" isn't available — it may be disconnected. Reconnect it, or choose a different microphone in the audio settings below, then try again.
